language_task: Place the yellow block next to the blue rectangle.
outcome_evidence: Frames 0–61 in wrist_cam show the yellow block between the gripper fingers during positioning. The fingers open in frames 62–70, and the arm withdraws in frames 72–100. Frames 80–100 and 240 in left_base_cam and right_base_cam show the released yellow block standing on the table beside the blue rectangle; wrist_cam also shows their neighboring positions after withdrawal. The placement remains stable through frame 240, with no visible failed attempt or unintended disturbance of other objects.
